entries.5a77cfa49a8b5e86: This is a large-scale renovation business that regenerates housing by making use of the existing building's foundations, columns, beams and other structure. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,201 million, and orders received totaled 6,559 buildings. The company explains that the product grew out of the idea, prompted by the Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake of 1995, of whether housing could be regenerated at a lower cost than rebuilding and with greater earthquake resistance. It describes the product as featuring reliable seismic reinforcement and a fixed-price system.

entries.8a8eaccfd6f37d33: About 1,800 tenant companies, from large corporations to venture companies, occupy the office buildings. Individuals purchase condominiums and detached houses; the Housing Business receives construction contracts from clients who rebuild or renovate their homes; and the Step Business receives brokerage fees from individuals and corporations that buy and sell real estate. Because net sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of consolidated net sales, the Securities Report omits regional information. No single counterparty accounts for 10% of net sales.

entries.92f244580b60dbae: This segment leases and manages office buildings, condominiums and other properties, and operates and manages hotels, event halls, commercial facilities and other properties. Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. itself develops and leases office buildings and high-end rental condominiums (La Tour), Sumitomo Fudosan Vilafontaine Co., Ltd. operates hotels, Sumitomo Fudosan Bellesalle Co., Ltd. leases and operates event halls, conference rooms and similar spaces, and Sumitomo Fudosan Commercial Management Co., Ltd. leases and operates commercial facilities and other properties. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥458,075 million and segment profit was ¥210,181 million, making it the largest of the 4 business segments in both net sales and profit. The company explains that the operating profit of this segment accounts for close to 7 tenths of the total. The vacancy rate of existing buildings at the end of the period was 4.3% (an improvement of 1.5 percentage points from the end of the previous period).
entries.93aee895d43b04ad: Brokerage fees from real estate transactions (same period: ¥73,293 million)
entries.95318aa08fc0563b: A real estate company that develops and leases office buildings mainly in central Tokyo, and also handles condominium sales, renovation and contract construction of detached houses, and real estate brokerage.
entries.9e51aed9e2109520: This is leasing centered on office buildings. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer revenue was ¥404,878 million, accounting for the majority of real estate leasing revenue. The company states that 95% of its leased office buildings are located in Tokyo's 23 wards, 84% are located in central Tokyo (the central seven wards), and its total owned floor area exceeds 1.5 million tsubo. In the current period, improved occupancy at existing buildings, the spread of rent increases, and full-year operation of Sumitomo Fudosan Nakano Ekimae Building and Sumitomo Fudosan Shinjuku Minamiguchi Building contributed.
entries.a1b93c1dfae544f0: About 1,800 tenant companies, from large corporations to venture companies, occupy the office buildings.
entries.a6ad434652dab7b8: The company describes its greatest strength as creating land, in central Tokyo where large sites are scarce, through redevelopment methods that assemble fragmented plots and adjust the rights of landowners. It holds the office buildings it builds rather than selling them and leases them out; 95% of its leased office buildings are located in Tokyo’s 23 wards, and 84% are located in central Tokyo (the central seven wards). As growth investments, it plans large-scale redevelopment projects in central Tokyo at Roppongi, Yaesu, Tsukiji, Ikebukuro and Iidabashi, with planned owned floor area of about 600,000 tsubo and total investment, including existing investment, exceeding ¥2.6 trillion, as well as a plan to invest ¥1 trillion in Mumbai, India. Increases in property, plant and equipment and intangible assets for the fiscal year ended March 2026 totaled ¥141,888 million.

entries.d4c259f5e1586c48: This segment undertakes construction and renovation work for detached houses. Sumitomo Fudosan Housing Co., Ltd., which took over the construction business of Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. through an absorption-type company split on April 1, 2025, is in charge and carries out the 'Shinchiku Sokkurisan' rebuilding business and the construction contracting business for new detached houses and other new housing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥188,702 million, and segment profit was ¥13,420 million. Orders received in the same period totaled 8,345 buildings (6,559 for Shinchiku Sokkurisan and 1,786 for custom-built homes). The company cites as reasons for the sharp decline in profit the substantial fall in orders, mainly in the first half, due to the impact of the revision of the Building Standards Act, and the costs incurred with the company split.

entries.e222978c2c231ee0: This segment develops and sells condominiums, detached houses, residential land and other properties, and manages them after sale. Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. itself handles development and sales, Sumitomo Fudosan Tatemono Service Co., Ltd. handles management of condominiums after sale, and Sumitomo Fudosan Sisukon Co., Ltd. handles interior sales. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥323,174 million and segment profit was ¥76,223 million. In that fiscal year, 3,368 units of condominiums, detached houses and residential land combined were recorded as sold, and the number of condominium contracts was 2,398 units. The company explains that 9 tenths of this segment is accounted for by condominiums for sale.
entries.e4387bd75e0980db: Operating income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥299,155 million, and ordinary income was ¥289,233 million. Segment profit (on an operating income basis) was ¥210,181 million for Real Estate Leasing, ¥76,223 million for Real Estate Sales, ¥23,601 million for Step, ¥13,420 million for Housing and ¥5,452 million for Other, to which an adjustment for corporate expenses and other items of △¥29,724 million is added. Ordinary income is below operating income because, according to the company, non-operating income and expenses deteriorated by ¥6.7 billion year on year due to increased interest payments and other factors.
